title: Card-Type Specification: Activation Hold, Reload Limits and Balance Ceiling (Cartwise Gift Cards)
content:
Each card type in the Cartwise Gift Cards range carries four specification figures that govern how its value can be held: the activation hold after purchase, whether value can be added after purchase, the size of a single reload, and the largest balance the card may carry.

| Card type | Activation hold after purchase | Reloadable | Smallest reload | Largest single reload | Largest balance the card may carry |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise eGift Card | 4 hours | No | 0.00 | 0.00 | 500.00 |
| Cartwise Plastic Gift Card | 0 hours | No | 0.00 | 0.00 | 200.00 |
| Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card | 4 hours | Yes | 10.00 | 500.00 | 1000.00 |
| Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card | 4 hours | No | 0.00 | 0.00 | 300.00 |
| Cartwise Corporate Gift Card | 24 hours | No | 0.00 | 0.00 | 500.00 |
| Cartwise Corporate Premium Gift Card | 24 hours | Yes | 100.00 | 2000.00 | 5000.00 |

All amounts are in US dollars.

## Definitions

**Activation hold.** The number of whole hours after purchase before the card can be redeemed. A hold of 0 hours means the card can be redeemed from the moment of purchase.

**Reloadable.** Whether value can be added to the card after purchase. Only two card types are reloadable: the Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card and the Cartwise Corporate Premium Gift Card.

**Smallest reload and largest single reload.** The bounds on the amount of one reload. A figure of 0.00 in both columns marks a card type that is not reloadable.

**Largest balance.** The ceiling on the value the card may carry at any time.

## Reading the specification

- The two reloadable types differ in scale: a single reload on a Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card runs from 10.00 to 500.00, and on a Cartwise Corporate Premium Gift Card from 100.00 to 2000.00, both bounds included.
- The balance ceiling is independent of the largest face value at purchase. For instance, a Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card may carry up to 1000.00, which is more than any single reload on that type.

### Hypothetical specification check (illustrative inputs only)

| Card type | Proposed reload | Within the single-reload bounds? |
|---|---|---|
| Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card | 9.99 | No — below 10.00 |
| Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card | 10.00 | Yes — equal to the smallest reload |
| Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card | 500.00 | Yes — equal to the largest single reload |
| Cartwise Corporate Premium Gift Card | 2000.01 | No — above 2000.00 |
| Cartwise eGift Card | any amount | No — the type is not reloadable |
